audit.sentence: That is not a complete confound — a complete one (all controls on one lane, all treated on the other) would make the treatment effect and the lane effect the same number and the test uninterpretable.

audit.sentence: Here they are only correlated (r ≈ 0.33), so the two are separable in principle.

audit.sentence: But any systematic L001-vs-L002 difference will load partly onto the condition term, biasing fold changes in whichever direction the lane effect runs.

audit.sentence: The structural catch: _config/rnaseq_bulk.yaml offers ~ batch + condition as the way to control for exactly this, but every formula term must be a column of the design table, and both the wrapper's check (rnaseq_de.py:226) and the stage 02 menu builder (configure.py:362) reject a term that is not.
